gen-gf-architects-daughter-fs-supreme: Relaxed handwriting leads in Architects Daughter, its s curves flung open at both ends. And Supreme follows in sturdy sans-serif, dense through the middle of each line, with a taller lowercase that stands up against the heading.
gen-gf-architects-daughter-general-sans: Loose, hand-lettered charm up top, with diagonals that echo the stems of Architects Daughter. But General Sans keeps a steady pressure below, its tall x-height filling each line like a clear, smooth sans.
gen-gf-architects-daughter-gf-bhutuka-ex: BhuTuka Expanded One slows the pace to a leisurely walk, its curvy letters feeling unclamped and its joins as sturdy as the stems. Then Architects Daughter scribbles above it, so the hand-drawn looseness meets a bookish, authoritative weight.
gen-gf-architects-daughter-gf-hepta-slab: Dignified is the first word for Hepta Slab, a serif whose open counters breathe out into the white space. And Architects Daughter above it adds a hand-drawn looseness, so a long passage feels stretched out and unhurried.
gen-gf-architects-daughter-gf-kiwi-maru: Scribbled warmth meets print tradition. Architects Daughter writes its loose, hand-drawn headings while Kiwi Maru follows with generous letterspace and terminals that stop far from the stem, giving the page an editorial calm.
gen-gf-architects-daughter-gf-orbit: Graceful in its handwriting, Architects Daughter sets up Orbit, a sans whose curves stop short instead of closing in. And a longer read keeps that floating, rope-like consistency, each character resting apart from its neighbor.
gen-gf-architects-daughter-gf-padyakke-e: Padyakke Expanded One spreads its glyphs like knots on a slack rope, each c opening like the mouth of a pitcher beneath Architects Daughter's relaxed hand. Its loose handwriting against round, unswelling bowls is the strongest thing here.
gen-gf-architects-daughter-gf-science-go: A loose, hand-drawn swagger up top, courtesy of Architects Daughter. But Science Gothic stays approachable below, a sans with stroke ends set far apart and no thick and thin parts, so each letter reads one at a time.
gen-gf-architects-daughter-gf-stint-ultr: Traditional text serif, held loosely. Stint Ultra Expanded lets each character float apart with a pipe-cleaner feel, and beneath Architects Daughter's graceful, hand-drawn curves, that spaced-out looseness is the quality the pair shares.
gen-gf-architects-daughter-gf-syncopate: Syncopate sits below Architects Daughter with technical-pen steadiness, its spacing like rungs on a rope ladder. And if the sans gets more size than the handwritten heading, its open shapes start to read like drafting lines.
